purpose: Corrected executable LayerZero bounded static validation parcel. This replaces the malformed metadata-only parcel REAPER-LAYERZERO-STATIC-20261006-0958-001 without deleting it. Local/public-source analysis only; no live target probing, transactions, disclosure, spend, credentials, or submission.
command:
set -euo pipefail
tmp=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
cd "$tmp"
echo "===SOURCE_FREEZE==="
git clone -q --filter=blob:none https://github.com/LayerZero-Labs/LayerZero-v2.git lz
cd lz
git checkout -q 9c741e7f9790639537b1710a203bcdfd73b0b9ac
echo "COMMIT=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
p='packages/layerzero-v2/evm/messagelib/contracts/Executor.sol'
test -f "$p"
sha256sum "$p"
echo "===NATIVE_DROP_PATHS==="
git grep -n -E 'nativeDropAndExecute302|function _nativeDrop|NativeDropApplied|spent \+=' -- "$p" || true
echo "===EXECUTOR_RELEVANT_SOURCE==="
awk 'BEGIN{show=0;c=0} /function nativeDropAndExecute302\(/ {show=1;c=0} /function _nativeDrop\(/ {show=1;c=0} show{print NR ":" $0;c++} c>85{show=0}' "$p" | head -240
echo "===HISTORY_DEDUPE==="
git log --oneline --all -S'nativeDropAndExecute302' -- "$p" | head -60 || true
git log --oneline --all -S'NativeDropApplied' -- "$p" | head -60 || true
git log --oneline --all --grep='native drop' -i | head -80 || true
echo "===PUBLIC_AUDIT_REPO_KEYWORD_CHECK==="
cd "$tmp"
git clone -q --depth 1 https://github.com/LayerZero-Labs/Audits.git audits || true
if [ -d audits ]; then
  cd audits
  grep -RniE 'native.?drop|nativeDropAndExecute302|Executor\.sol' . --exclude-dir=.git | head -160 || true
else
  echo "AUDITS_REPO_UNAVAILABLE"
fi
echo "LAYERZERO_STATIC_VALIDATION_DONE"
